verdict.rationale: Glama offers a browser-based MCP Inspector for testing any MCP server, including local dev servers exposed through an mcp-proxy tunnel. Hosted deployments are private by default, which allows pre-release testing, and per-tool access control can disable individual tools. None of this is described as an isolated sandbox that keeps production data out of reach. Missing for 10: an explicit sandbox or test environment, documented isolation from production data or credentials, separate staging versus production environments, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
